data.title: Intense pulsed light (IPL)
data.summary: Cryo / electro / light devices · Non-laser xenon flash-lamp source emitting broad-spectrum light (500-1200 nm) that is filtered for the target.
data.body:
_Also called: IPL_

Non-laser xenon flash-lamp source emitting broad-spectrum light (500-1200 nm) that is filtered for the target.

## Parts
- Xenon flash lamp
- Cut-off filters

## Uses / indications
- Hair reduction
- Non-ablative rejuvenation
- Hyperpigmentation (mixed type)

## Viva points & tips
- Not a laser: non-coherent, polychromatic; filters let one machine do many tasks
